visionary.heading: The Visionary
visionary.description:
Born in Bandung, Arkiv is a globally acclaimed contemporary artist bridging lowbrow art and high-end galleries. Trained as an architect, he translates structured spatial awareness into liberating, fluid visual narratives.

His distinct style catapulted him from vinyl art toys to massive global canvases, defining a new era of Indonesian contemporary art.

product.heading: MEET SARU REIMAGINED
product.description: This isn't just an extinguisher—it’s a certified dual-purpose masterpiece. Engineered to neutralize battery fires instantly, it is cloaked in the bold silhouette of Arkiv’s Saru: an anchor of cool built from the DNA of KAWS, Megaman, and Rockman. Broad-shouldered and steadfast with a quiet heroic intensity, Saru embodies raw resilience—yet beneath its armored exterior lies a gentle protector, proving that true strength is the courage to remain tender after the battle.
product.statement: Evolving safety into a centerpiece you’ll want to display.

whyArt.title: Why Art?
whyArt.content: For too long, safety was hidden in dark cupboards. We are using art to educate, disrupt, and elevate fire safety from an eyesore to a highlight.
